purpose: paired exploratory question-level history ablation on reviewer-identified reference cases
selection: All seven three-turn candidates identified by the external reviewer; deliberately selected, not representative.

cases.target_query: In what exact campaigns does it discuss those investors' influence?

proposed_controlled_history.query: Which pension fund is named, and which state is it associated with?
What other kinds of investor does the excerpt list alongside pension funds?
proposed_controlled_history.reference_answer_suggestion: Endowments and other big activist investors.

cases.target_query: Roughly how long before IBM's announcement did it claim the title?

proposed_controlled_history.query: What did IBM announce about a computer it developed?
proposed_controlled_history.reference_answer_suggestion: It said it had developed the world's fastest computer.

proposed_controlled_history.query: Whose machine had previously claimed that title?

cases.target_query: Which computer platforms was it available for?

proposed_controlled_history.reference_answer_suggestion: A free screensaver called "Make Love Not Spam".

proposed_controlled_history.query: What was the screensaver intended to do to spam servers?

cases.target_query: On which day does the excerpt say it was signed?

proposed_controlled_history.query: Who signed the legislation? Cite the name.
Which department receives the funding? Cite its name.

cases.target_query: Who made that statement, according to news reports?

proposed_controlled_history.query: What does the report say Chechen security forces did?
Who was allegedly among those killed?
proposed_controlled_history.reference_answer_suggestion: The alleged leader of the assassination of the republic's president.

cases.offline_reference_answer_suggestion: Chechen deputy prime minister Ramzan Kadyrov.

cases.target_query: How does the article assess those two coaches?

proposed_controlled_history.query: Which two coaches does the article discuss?

cases.offline_reference_answer_suggestion: It calls them arguably the most successful football coaches in America right now.

cases.target_query: For which state was he insurance commissioner?

proposed_controlled_history.query: Which two companies won approval to merge?
Who gave the approval described in the excerpt?

conditions.with_history: Give the same fixed source material plus two previous questions and their source-supported draft answers, followed by the same third question.
conditions.without_history: Give the same fixed source material and same third question, with no previous questions or answers.

controls: Same source text, source order, model, system instruction, decoding settings and output limit across each pair.
Prior answers are draft teacher-forced context, not actual previous service outputs; review their correctness and ensure they do not directly include the third answer before running.
Separate offline answer suggestions from model-facing input. Source IDs are experiment metadata, not attack labels.
Use new run and condition-specific session identity; do not reuse prior traces. Log model version, actual prompts, seed availability, failures and raw outputs.
Judge textual correctness and whether the referent is resolved using a predeclared rubric; calculate per-case paired changes and retain individual disagreements.
Optional order randomization and repeat settings must be fixed before examining results; do not treat correlated pairs as independent documents.
limitations: Design is not a run and proves neither history necessity nor actual Session/fusion activation.
Only seven model-selected reference examples; ambiguity can sometimes be resolved from the supplied source without dialog history.
Teacher-forced context can steer answers and does not reproduce end-to-end generated histories, so its result cannot be claimed as deployed-system defense effect.
All answer suggestions remain pending human verification; no formal gold or final test release.
